extraction_notes: The PDF identifies 8205A as a 20 V N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET and gives TSSOP-8 and SOT-23-6 package options.
VGS(th) is published as minimum 0.5 V and maximum 1.5 V at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA; no typical value is published.
RDS(on) is published at VGS = 1.8 V, ID = 2.0 A; VGS = 2.5 V, ID = 3.5 A; and VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 4.5 A. Both typical and maximum values are retained for each condition.
The PDF contains no electrical-characteristics curve plots. Page 3 is blank apart from the title and watermark, so no curve points were extracted.

The table also publishes IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = 20 V, VGS = 0 V; IGSS maximum +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V and ID = 0; gfs typical 29 S at VDS = 15 V and ID = 6 A; and Qg typical 6.24 nC, maximum 8.11 nC at VDS = 10 V and ID = 6 A. These fields are not represented by the strict schema.

Absolute maximum ratings are VDS = 20 V, VGS = +/-12 V, continuous ID = 6 A at Ta = 25 degC, pulsed IDM = 20 A, PD = 2 W at Ta = 25 degC and 1.3 W at Ta = 75 degC, and TJ/Tstg = -55 to 150 degC. RthetaJA is 62.5 degC/W for PCB mounting.
omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no usable electrical characteristic curves, capacitance values, or body-diode forward-voltage value. Reverse recovery, switching-time, gate-charge, leakage, transconductance, and thermal fields beyond those noted are not represented by the strict extraction schema.
